preservedResponsibilities: Owns plain local and central headers, descriptors and ZIP64 extra fields. Retains the original entry task, temporary-file replay, package-member update and exception_ptr ownership. The browser explicitly selects the source no-worker pool, draining to the queue bound before adding the next task and preserving reverse final replay. Task failures are rethrown after the central directory and END.
omittedResponsibilities: The browser runs archive work in its current realm; shared physical worker scheduling, encryption and native ABI domains are unqualified.
